checks.text: On initial load, the page shows the heading "2048 Game", a 4x4 grid with exactly two tiles containing the value "2", a score display showing "Score: 0", and a best score display showing "Best: 0".
With a board containing a single "2" tile in the top-left corner and empty cells elsewhere, pressing the ArrowRight key moves that tile to the top-right corner, and the score remains "Score: 0".

With a board containing a "2" tile in the top-left and a "2" tile in the top-right, pressing the ArrowRight key merges them into a single "4" tile in the top-right corner, and the score display updates to "Score: 4".

With a board containing a "4" tile in the top-left and a "2" tile in the top-right, pressing the ArrowRight key moves the "2" to the top-middle and the "4" to the top-right, with no merge occurring and the score remaining unchanged.
Clicking the button labeled "New Game" resets the board to a fresh state with exactly two "2" tiles, resets the score to "Score: 0", and preserves the previous best score value in the "Best" display.
When the board is full and no merges are possible, the page displays the text "Game Over" and the button labeled "New Game" remains clickable.
When a tile with the value "2048" is created on the board, the page displays the text "You Win!" and the button labeled "Keep Going" appears, allowing the player to continue playing.
Pressing the ArrowUp key on a board with a "2" in the bottom-left moves it to the top-left, and pressing ArrowDown moves it back to the bottom-left, with the score remaining "Score: 0" throughout.
Reload keeps the current board state, score, and best score: after making a move that results in "Score: 4", reloading the page still shows the merged "4" tile and "Score: 4".
